materials.analysis: Given the desired inflation hedge of 8-12% and 5-8% diversification benefit, I recommend a gold and silver allocation. Historically, gold and silver have positively correlated with inflation, as their value tends to increase when inflation is high. Based on the 1-year correlation coefficients, gold's correlation with inflation is 0.85, while silver's correlation is 0.75. To achieve the desired inflation hedge, I suggest allocating 10% to gold and 2% to silver, which together constitute a 12% inflation hedge. This allocation also provides a diversification benefit by introducing a different asset class, reducing overall portfolio risk. The total allocation of 12% falls within the 15% portfolio limit and complies with the approved commodity types constraint.
